query: How does the kubelet decide to evict pods when the node is under memory or disk pressure?

matches.reason: Core periodic decision loop: computes signal observations, determines which eviction thresholds are met (and past grace period), tries node-level reclaim first, ranks active pods, and evicts the top-ranked pod when memory/disk pressure thresholds are violated.
Determines whether observed resource availability (memory/disk/etc.) violates configured hard/soft eviction thresholds, the core pressure-detection logic.
Defines how candidate pods are ordered for eviction under memory pressure vs. disk pressure (by usage exceeding requests, priority, then absolute usage).
Maps each eviction signal (memory available, node/image/container fs available or inodes free) to its pod-ranking function, wiring memory vs. disk pressure to distinct eviction ordering strategies.
